about_the_game:
An escape room-style text adventure. You awaken in an abandoned hospital with only your wits to guide you. Navigate eerie corridors, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets as you piece together the mystery lurking within.

What to Expect:

  • Dual Command Interfaces:

    • Hospital Navigation: Roam the eerie corridors using classic text-adventure commands like look, go, get, and use. Every command reveals hidden details and unlocks new areas of the hospital.

    • Computer Terminal: When it's time to access the deeper secrets, the hospital’s computer system becomes your gateway. Use authentic commands to sift through system logs and unveil the hidden truth.

  • A Haunting Atmosphere:
    Immerse yourself in a world steeped in horror and suspense. Creatures in the dark hallways and subtle ambient sounds intensify each moment.

  • Intricate Puzzle Solving:
    The hospital is filled with carefully crafted puzzle that demands both logic and intuition. Piece together clues scattered across the hospital and within its computer terminals to gradually reveal the dark history behind your predicament.

  • Multiple Endings:
    Your decisions shape your destiny. With multiple outcomes, the elusive true ending is the most difficult to discover.

  • Hidden Secrets and Easter Eggs:
    Meticulous exploration rewards the observant. Discover concealed details and an easter egg audio clip—a special song playable on demand—for those who dive deep into every corner of this eerie world.

  • Arachnophobia Mode:
    To accommodate those who prefer to avoid encounters with eight-legged terrors, an optional mode is available from the start screen.

Your Ultimate Challenge:
Can you piece together the fragmented past, master both the hospital's text-based exploration and the terminal's secrets, and ultimately escape with your life? Every keystroke inches you closer to revealing the truth behind the unknown. Prepare to confront the darkness—if you dare.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4-compliant onboard graphics
  • Storage: 175 MB available space
